Community bot for the Marwie AI App Builders server with moderation, tickets, temporary voice rooms, quizzes and anonymous questions. Settings can also be changed from a web control panel.
[One or two sentences on the hardest part, and how you solved it.]

A setting changed on the web dashboard is queued in Postgres. A webhook message wakes the bot, which applies the change to the server, and the result shows back on the site. The bot never serves HTTP and the site never reaches it directly.
